name: onebucket
description: Connect OneBucket S3 storage and its storage-event stream, and work with objects of any size — including large binary files that exceed inline limits.

endpoint.title: OneBucket storage endpoint
endpoint.description: MCP URL for object operations. Keep the default: it is routed to the nearest region. Override only to pin a region (https://data.cluster7.onebucket.io, https://data.cluster8.onebucket.io) or to reach a private cluster.

events_endpoint.title: OneBucket events endpoint
events_endpoint.description: MCP URL for the storage-event stream. Keep the default: it is routed to the nearest region. Override only to pin a region (https://synapse.cluster7.onebucket.io, https://synapse.cluster8.onebucket.io) or to reach a private cluster.
